shorts.title: Good Money Models Help Businesses Become "King of the Jungle"

shorts.description:
The rumors are true...
There IS a “million-dollar secret” that successful entrepreneurs don't want you to know.
It’s not a morning routine. It's not a product. It's not a service. It's not a marketing tactic.
It's a way of thinking.
Most entrepreneurs think in transactions:
How do I get someone to buy something?
How do I make this sale?
How do I get more customers?
Million-dollar entrepreneurs think in relationships:
How do I help someone solve their whole problem?
How do I become indispensable to this customer?
How do I get customers to never want to leave?
Transaction thinking creates one-time buyers. Relationship thinking creates lifetime customers.
Here's a real example:
Transaction approach: Sell someone a $2,000 website and move on to the next customer.
Relationship approach: Build someone a $2,000 website, then offer $500/month hosting, then $1,000/month marketing, then $300/month maintenance, then help them scale with new projects.
Same customer. Same starting point. $2,000 vs. $50,000+ over time.
The transaction entrepreneur moves on after the first sale. The relationship entrepreneur builds an empire with the same customers.
This is exactly what "$100M Money Models" teaches. How to shift from transaction thinking to relationship thinking.
Saturday August 16th at 9am PST (12pm EST), I'm doing a FREE live event to reveal this million-dollar secret.
You'll learn how to build an empire instead of just making sales.
PS - Preorder a book on the way in and you'll get instantly upgraded to VIP and get 4 amazing free bonuses :)

shorts.description:
“$100M MONEY MODELS” launches on Sat 8/16.
It’s a book that will teach you how to get more customers, to spend more, in less time, over and over again with your business.
And few people know this but…
I started writing it 472 days ago.
I thought I was just documenting what I'd learned from 15 years in business. 
Turns out, I was discovering patterns I'd never seen before.
Like this:
Every successful business follows the same 4-step sequence:
1 - Get customers cheaper than competitors
2 - Make more money from each customer
3 - Get customers to buy repeatedly
4 - Reinvest profits to get more customers
It sounds simple. But most businesses only do step 1. They spend all their time trying to get customers cheaper.
The smart businesses focus on steps 2-4. They make more money from each customer, so they can afford to pay more to get customers.
It's like having a bigger advertising budget than everyone else. Instantly.
I spent 472 days documenting exactly how this works. The specific tactics. The proven frameworks. The step-by-step systems.
The result is "$100M Money Models".
Everything I wish I'd known when I started my first business.
If I had this book 15 years ago, I would have saved myself millions of dollars in mistakes and years of trial and error.
On Saturday August 16th at 12pm EST (9am PST)
I'm doing a FREE live event to share what took me 472 days to figure out.
